videos.desc: On a summer porch, a big glass jar of lemonade with lemon slices, mint and ice is stirred and poured into tall glasses; a woman takes a long refreshing drink and friends clink their glasses for a refill.
videos.said: Ice cold, here it comes! Refill please!

videos.desc: At a backyard brick barbecue at sunset, a man in an apron grills ribs, a thick steak and sausages over glowing coals, turning them with tongs while they sizzle. He piles the browned pieces onto a wooden board and carries the board of grilled meat toward a set table while a dog watches.
videos.said: Listen that sound Golden to the table

videos.desc: In a farmhouse kitchen with green fields outside, a woman opens a glass bottle of fresh milk and pours it into a tall glass. She gulps it all down and turns around wearing a huge white milk moustache, then she and a man clink their glasses, both sporting milk moustaches, while a cat laps milk from a bowl.
videos.said: Pour it all. The moustache classic.

videos.desc: At a cafe table by a fountain, a woman twists the cap off a green glass bottle of mineral water and pours it fizzing over ice into a glass. She listens to the bubbles, sips, giggles at the tickle, and pours a glass for her friend so they can clink and drink together.

A couple sits at a wooden garden table in autumn with a bowl of walnuts. The man cracks one open with a metal nutcracker, shows the two shell halves with the kernel inside, and they both snack on the nuts happily.

In a sunny Greek-style kitchen, golden olive oil is poured slowly from a bottle into a dish, pooling in circles. Tomato slices are laid in the oil, and a couple dips chunks of fresh bread into a small bowl of it and eats with delight.

In an Italian kitchen a chef fans dry spaghetti into a big pot, boils and tastes it, lifts the strands with tongs into a pan of tomato sauce, then serves a tall twirled tower of pasta on a plate that a woman happily slurps.
videos.said: Find it! In they go! Now twirl it!

videos.desc: A young barman in an apron pours orange juice from a big plastic jug into a row of glasses on a wooden counter, filling them one by one. He shows off by pouring from higher and higher - "Steady, steady. Not a drop!" - while a woman watches open-mouthed, and every glass ends up neatly filled.
videos.said: (upbeat music) - Steady, steady. - Not a drop!

videos.desc: A young man in a kitchen tears lettuce into a bowl, slices cucumber, cherry tomatoes and peppers, adds red onion and white cheese, and tosses everything with two spoons; he lines up a row of bowls and a friend tastes one with a fork, nodding approval.

At a lakeside picnic a woman builds a sandwich on a wooden board: she butters white bread, layers ham, cheese, tomato, lettuce and cucumber, presses a second slice on top and cuts it in half to show the striped filling, then happily takes a bite while a duck watches.
videos.said: layer layer layer crown look at those stripes

videos.desc: At an outdoor table by a vineyard, a man ladles bright green herb sauce from a stone bowl over a plate of grilled potatoes, aubergine and pepper; egged on by his partner shouting for more, he keeps pouring until the whole plate is flooded in sauce, and they taste it laughing.

At a campsite between mountains and a fjord, a man fries a row of sausages in a black pan on a small camp stove, turning them with tongs until browned; he lifts one on a fork, pops it into a long bun and a woman wrapped in a blanket takes a happy bite.
videos.said: Roll them. Roll them. Snap. Hear that?

videos.desc: A Pixar-style animated woman carries a tray of steaming noodle bowls across a sunset terrace, sets a bowl in front of a delighted man at the table saying 'Here you go', then pours water from a clay jug into his glass.

In a Pixar-style 3D supermarket, a young woman with curly red hair pushes a cart along the shelves, picks out apples, bread and a carton of milk, pays the cashier with coins and walks off happily with her bag.
A woman at a juice bar blends berries and fruit into a thick purple drink, pours it into tall glasses, tops each with a strawberry, sips through a straw, and her friends clink their glasses together.

At a rooftop picnic, a man suspects his friend shook his orange soda can, holds it to his ear and listens before daring to open it; nothing explodes, so he pours the fizzy orange soda over ice, drinks, and grins in relief.

A man lines up a teaspoon, a soup spoon and a giant ladle on a wooden table, then eats his bowl of vegetable soup testing them by size: tiny sips with the teaspoon, proper spoonfuls with the soup spoon, and finally huge comic mouthfuls straight from the ladle until the bowl is empty.
videos.said: That's not nothing! Now you're eating!

videos.desc: In a cozy log cabin, a woman tastes steaming tomato soup from a big pot, ladles it into a bowl, swirls cream on top and hands it to a man wrapped in a blanket on the sofa, who blows on each hot spoonful and eats it happily with a cat beside him.
videos.said: hot hot hot careful warms everything

videos.desc: A cartoon woman at an outdoor picnic table laughs and waves, knocking over a full glass of water; the water floods the whole table and drips onto the grass while she and a boy stare in shock.
In a sunny bakery a worker pulls white string from a spool, loops and crosses it around a white pastry box, ties a neat bow, and the customer carries the box away hanging from the string.
A woman sips black coffee in a cafe and grimaces at the bitter taste; her partner spoons white sugar from a small bowl into the cup and stirs it, and her next sip makes her smile.
videos.said: Whoo strong for courage Now it's right

videos.desc: On a Moroccan-style tiled table, a couple spoons dried leaves and fresh mint into a glass teapot, pours in hot water, watches the brew turn amber, then pours the tea into small glasses from high up and sips it together.
videos.said: Look, they're dancing! From up here, steady.

videos.desc: A young vegetable seller at a busy market clutches his dry throat, tips up his water bottle and finds it empty, then gratefully takes a glass of water a hand passes him and gulps it down in one go.

At sunset in a garden, a man picks a big ripe tomato off the vine, smells it, then slices it into a stack on a wooden board, salts it and adds a basil leaf; he bites into a juicy slice and shares the board with a woman.
videos.said: still warm smell that juicy look at it

videos.desc: In a vineyard a woman touches a bunch of dark grapes on the vine, then pours red wine from a bottle into a glass at a small table. She swirls it, smells it, sips, and clinks glasses with a man as the sun sets over the rows of vines.
videos.said: Swirl and smell. The grapes right there.

videos.desc: At a kitchen table a woman turns a jar of thick white yogurt upside down to show it does not pour, spoons the creamy yogurt into a bowl, drizzles honey and adds berries and oats, then eats a big spoonful while her boyfriend watches amazed.

A couple sit at a square table with a white cloth on a beach at dusk, palm trees and the sea behind them and a lantern with a lit candle in the middle of the table. A waiter in a white jacket sets down their food and steps back. In front of the woman is a plate of green salad; in front of the man a burger with a pile of chips. He picks the burger up in both hands and takes a big bite, then grins at the camera. The two of them talk and laugh over their plates with wine glasses beside them.

On a white marble worktop two ribbed mugs of black coffee stand side by side, one teal and one orange, with a large knife lying behind them. The knife slices straight down through the orange mug, and the two halves fall open to show layers of sponge and chocolate inside: it is a cake. The shot changes to three pale ears of corn lying in a row on the marble, their husks still attached. The knife comes down through the middle ear and cuts it lengthways, opening it to reveal that it too is a cake, with a yellow sponge inside and rounded yellow dots along the cut face.

A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.

A hamster sits on a grey sofa in a dim room and works through one small meal after another straight to camera: a cheeseburger with a red paper cup of soda, a red pot of instant noodles eaten with chopsticks, a pink tub of yoghurt with a spoon, a corn dog covered in ketchup, then a slice of strawberry cream cake with a fork, ending with cream on its nose. Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.

A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.

A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.

A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.

A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

A young man in a blue apron stands at a white kitchen counter with an open box of two chocolate doughnuts on one side and a bowl of strawberries on the other, and points away from the doughnuts. He puts out three empty plastic food containers and fills them with chicken, quinoa, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, then stacks the filled containers into a tall tower and sets the bowl of strawberries on top.

In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.

A run of close-up shots of different people eating. A bearded man bites into a dripping cheeseburger in a fast-food restaurant; a woman lifts a mouthful of ramen noodles out of a bowl with chopsticks and sucks them in; a man in a canteen forks food off a plate of fried fish, chips and salad; a boy with curly hair takes a bite out of an enormous triple cheeseburger held in both hands.
